title: Translate HTML
summary: Translates semantic HTML in parallel 32k-character batches with translation memory while preserving declarations, markup, behavior, links, and shared assets.

batchSubmission.validation: Exact per-batch schema and native validation before atomic save; accepted results are immutable
batchSubmission.correction: Optional --replace-sha256 with the current result digest for an evidenced correction; stale replacements are refused
